notes.title: 2.13.1 Update
notes.notes:
* Added [Rise of Heroes] script to the big picture
* Add blank material to custom avatar
* Fix the bug that can control the man-machine hero during battle
* The cost of the alliance has been modified to 500+50×Hate value
* Add the gender of the eunuch, the eunuch cannot be married
* Reinforcement can only be reinforced once per round
* Reduce advertising cooling time

notes.title: Update 2.12.6
notes.notes:
* You can copy the custom script of the computer to the mobile phone to play, and the mobile phone will be updated to 2.12.6 (only Android5~Android9, other mobile phone systems are not supported)
* Copy the script method, copy the entire folder steam/common/sanguos2/save_data/chapters to the phone sanguos2_file
* Add the gender of the eunuch, the eunuch cannot be married
* The editor can set the hero's parent

notes.title: Update 2.12.5
notes.notes:
* Fix the bug that can control man-machine generals during battle
* The cost of the alliance has been modified to 500+50×Hate value
* Reinforcement can only be reinforced once per round

Script editor updated to 1.1.0
* Fix the problem of data loss after the children who read more than 100 books and customized generals are archived
* Fix the bug that the monarch has loyalty
* Add scroll bar

notes.title: 2.9.0-2.10.0 Update content
notes.notes:
2.9.0 [/ b]
* Add a large map of 75 cities, create a new file, and select the large map mode to open
* Fixed a bug where subjugation continued during automatic combat
 2.10.0 [/ b]
* Adds a custom general feature that allows you to replace the monarch with a custom general on the power selection interface
* Add the setting to control the incubation time of player, man-machine is still 10 months
* Easy to cancel gem consumption, but not free to set options
* the lu/Jue shadow has been changed to attack bonus of 10 points and counter-attack bonus of 5%
* Add and delete archive function

notes.title: 2.7.9 update contents
